# `toolu docs`

Inspect and record documentation reviews.

Owner: `plugins/documentation-gate`.
Alias: `documentation-gate`.

## `toolu docs`

```text
Inspect and record documentation reviews

Usage: toolu docs [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  inspect      Inspect the committed diff
  route        Choose a ready documentation worker
  write-state  Record a completed review
  help         Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --json              Print exactly one JSON document on stdout
  -q, --quiet             Drop the diagnostics of a successful run
      --host <HOST>       The host to act for, instead of the detected one [possible values: claude, codex, cursor, hermes, muse]
      --config-dir <DIR>  Read the toolu config from DIR instead of the host's default
  -h, --help              Print help
```
